$doc: Minimum-passing-test floors. Enforced by scripts/test-floor.mjs (`pnpm test:floor`) — read that file's header first. Every `floor` here was MEASURED by `--record`, never guessed. A floor is a lower bound: if a run drops below it, tests stopped running or started failing. NEVER raise a floor to hide a newly-visible failure, and never lower one to make a red run green.

Wiring it needs a vitest config excluding dist, then a CI run to measure. Reported, not guessed.
